nodes.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), 4 ≤ d → Filter.Tendsto (fun q : ℕ => (Fintype.card {a : Fin d → Fin q // ∑ i, (a i).val ≤ ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.auxiliaryDegree q d} : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ^ d) Filter.atTop (nhds (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.limitingRate d))
nodes.proof_route: Use exact integer division inequalities to bound auxiliaryDegree(q,d)/q between (d-3)/2-d/q and (d-3)/2. Prove the coordinate-sum level set is a proper affine subspace and hence Lebesgue null. Dominated indicator convergence yields continuity of the actual cube-halfspace volume in its threshold. Partition the half-open unit cube into pairwise disjoint boxes [a_i/q,(a_i+1)/q). Their selected union has exact Lebesgue volume card(GridIndices)/q^d. Coordinatewise floors give the lower inclusion of the halfspace at R/q, after null upper faces are removed; summing box upper bounds gives the upper inclusion in the halfspace at (R+d)/q. Both thresholds converge to the same target, so real-valued volume squeeze proves the moving-degree natural-count limit. Finally apply the independently proved exact finite Reed--Muller dimension equality and fieldSize growth, preserving arbitrary mission Geometry choices and the exact rowCount denominator.
